correctness.rationale: The three-round recurrence reduces to an anchor with four quadrant partners, each realizing all 9 pair insertion cells. Each partner forces five distinct points in its anchor quadrant, giving 21. At equality each quadrant has 5 points and a unique local median with exactly four corner witnesses, one of 16 patterns. The cross-quadrant cell conditions reduce exactly to four independent mutual median-straddling binary interleavings, with L=binom(10,5)-42-42+12=180; uniquely reversible construction gives (16L)^4. Each rank-one witness pair fails rank two because its uniquely occupied outer insertion cell creates an empty triple insertion cell, proving rank exactly three. The extracted checker confirmed 16, 180, 250 constructed minimum hosts and 5250 one-vertex deletions; finite tests are corroboration, not the proof.
